name: Haft Review
description: Plant the feet shoulder wide and hold the halberd level at chest height so every later strike starts balanced.

name: Leaden Axefall
description: Raise the halberd over the shoulder and drop the axe blade straight down onto the opponent's head or collarbone.

name: Drag Bump
description: Push the spear point forward along the shaft line with the rear hand driving at the opponent's chest.

name: Holding Axeblade
description: Hold the shaft crosswise before the body to catch an incoming blow on the wood and turn it aside.

name: Backward Socketring
description: Slide the rear foot back one pace while drawing the halberd in to regain distance after a missed strike.

name: Langetlid
description: Reach the beak behind the opponent's ankle and pull sharply so the footing is lost and the stance breaks.

name: Tailstop Note
description: Set the lead hand near the head and the rear hand at the haft's end for leverage in every drill.

name: Gnawing Hookpull
description: Swing the axe blade upward from low guard to bite under the opponent's guard at ribs or forearm.

name: Descending Spikefall
description: Snap the spear point out a half pace with a quick rear-hand push and pull it back at once.

name: Beakstrike
description: Spin the halberd and strike with the butt end of the haft against the opponent's knee or hand.

name: Snatchskitter
description: Step off the line of attack and turn the shaft with the body so the head still faces the opponent.

name: Warm Hookback
description: Spread the stance wide and sink the hips so the halberd's weight rests on the legs and not the arms.

name: Easing Beak
description: Close distance with short gliding paces that keep the feet low and the halberd head steady throughout.

name: Langetdrop
description: Pivot on the lead foot and swing the axe blade in a flat arc to clear the space in front.

name: Haftbump
description: Step diagonally past the opponent's guard and lunge the spear point at the exposed flank.

name: Hitching Heave
description: Snag the beak on the opponent's belt or weapon arm and haul back to throw off the next attack.

name: Ready Spike
description: Give ground one pace while sweeping the haft across to knock a thrust wide of the body.

name: Sideways Axeheel
description: Circle the opponent at arm's reach with the halberd levelled so no opening is offered on any side.

name: Gentle Langet
description: Slide the rear hand along the haft to lengthen or shorten reach between one drill and the next.

name: Kind Spike
description: Grip the haft close under the head for tight close work where a long swing has no room.

name: Quick Crownspike
description: Chop the axe blade straight down in a repeated drill with the back foot stepping in behind each blow.

name: Beakdrop
description: Draw the axe blade across from high shoulder to opposite hip along a steep diagonal line.

name: Straight Snatch
description: Thrust the spear point straight ahead at a fixed mark while the heel anchors the push.

name: Fouling Hookback
description: Hook the beak over the opponent's wrist and drag it downward to pull the weapon out of line.

name: Axeblade Wedge
description: Lift the haft overhead with both hands to take a downward blow on the shaft and shed it.

name: Sideways Haft
description: Plant the lead heel and push off it to withdraw out of reach in one smooth movement.

name: Kept Crownspike
description: Hold the halberd out at full length across the front so the head and haft cover the whole body.

name: Snatchdash
description: Swing the axe blade in a wide controlled arc that lands with the heavy curved edge.

name: Gnawing Drag
description: Slide both hands to the rear of the haft and stab the spear point at the farthest reach.

name: Draghusk
description: Tap the back hook against the opponent's shin to stagger the lead step before the main cut.

name: Beak Wedge
description: Spin the shaft in a short circle in front of the body to flick away an incoming weapon.

name: Socketring Count
description: Carry the pole upright at the side with the spike skyward ready to lower into guard.

name: Leaden Spikefall
description: Poke the spike point at the opponent's face or throat from behind a lowered guard.

name: Beakhit
description: Hack at the opponent's arm or shoulder with a broad swing of the axe head.

name: Low Tailstop
description: Drive the shaft sideways into the opponent's chest with both hands to shove them back a step.

name: Planted Axeheel
description: Angle the pole across the body so the shaft covers the head and the spike covers the front.

name: Heavetrot
description: Slide both feet back together while the pole stays pointed at the opponent to cover the retreat.

name: Mild Tailstop
description: Time one steady breath to the settling of the stance so the circulating qi eases into the grip.

name: Tripping Langet
description: Tug the beak against a limb or weapon haft with a burst of breath to break the opponent's balance.

name: Level Axefall
description: Let out the breath as the axe blade falls so the whole body weight lands behind the cleave.

name: Gnawing Snatch
description: Hold the breath and thrust the spear point in one straight unbroken push at the chest.

name: Resting Beak
description: Catch an incoming weapon in the curve of the beak and twist the haft to carry it aside.

name: Easing Hookpull
description: Hop lightly on the heels to change the angle of approach while the halberd stays level.

name: Descending Axefall
description: Draw the axe blade back along the target with qi thinning the edge so the cut bites deeper.

name: Warm Langet
description: Line the shaft with the spine and the leading eye so the recruit's strikes travel straight.

name: Heavestrike
description: Swing the shaft level at the opponent's waist to knock them off line before the head follows.

name: Downward Spike
description: Prick the spear point at the opponent's leading hand to force the grip open.

name: Settled Haft
description: Spin the halberd in front of the body in a loose screen that catches thrown or thrust weapons.

name: Descending Drag
description: Slip one pace to the side and cut with the axe blade at the opponent's exposed ribs.

name: Lowered Socketring
description: Raise the halberd above the head at a slant so the shaft covers the head and shoulders.

name: Axeblade Husk
description: Lower the halberd head near the knees with the shaft slanting to cover the legs and belly.

name: Haftblow
description: Answer a parried blow at once with a slash of the axe blade at the opponent's open side.

name: Heavedrop
description: Answer a high parry with a spike stab driven under the opponent's raised weapon arm.

name: Tripping Axeheel
description: Turn the parry into a snag of the beak on the opponent's weapon and pull it out of line.

name: Dragskitter
description: Retreat in small steps while holding the guard so the halberd covers every pace backward.

name: Measured Crownspike
description: Loosen the grip between strikes so qi can speed the shaft through each turn and recovery.

name: Langetblow
description: Snap the axe blade down on a short wrist-driven chop that lands and recovers in one motion.

name: Snatchdrop
description: Snap the spear point out and back in a flicking jab aimed at the opponent's hand or face.

name: Snatchlid
description: Flick the beak against the opponent's weapon to spoil their timing for the next exchange.

name: Kept Hookback
description: Roll the shaft along an incoming blade to carry the blow off to the side without stopping it.

name: Light Hookpull
description: Dash sideways two quick paces with the pole held steady to come around the opponent's guard.

name: Straight Spikefall
description: Fire two spike jabs in quick succession at the same spot so the second finds the gap.

name: Langetdash
description: Sweep the shaft in a quick flat arc at knee height to drive back anyone close.

name: Crownspike Count
description: Hold the halberd with the beak and the spike both free to strike or to hook as needed.

name: Heavelid
description: Hook the beak behind the opponent's leg and pull so they trip and fall off balance.

name: Heaveblow
description: Follow a hook that has pulled the opponent forward with a spike thrust into the exposed body.

name: Turning Socketring
description: Catch the beak on the rim of a shield or the edge of a blade and hold it fast.

name: Angled Axeblade
description: Hold the hooked head forward and low so strikes at the legs catch on the curve and slide away.

name: Quiet Heave
description: Release a hooked limb and step back at once before the opponent can counter at close range.

name: Beak Note
description: Learn the exact pace where the axe blade just reaches and hold that distance throughout the bout.

name: Beakbump
description: Drop the axe blade on a steady count so each cleave lands in time with the footwork.

name: Sharp Snatch
description: Alternate one slow thrust and one fast thrust of the spear point to break the opponent's timing.

name: Solid Langet
description: Slip the haft along a blade in time with the opponent's own beat to turn the blow aside.

name: Langetskitter
description: Step suddenly past the edge of reach to break the measured distance and force a new rhythm.
